title: stale-login response guard in ExtractionReviewPage.reload is not pinned by its test
evidence: Removing `if (generation === epoch.current)` before setView in reload() (ExtractionReviewPage.tsx) leaves all 9 tests green (qa/evidence/u22-extraction-review-ui-checker/k7.summary.txt). The test 'fails closed for trusted-human refusal and discards a previous tenant response' calls finish() and goes straight to waitFor(...not.toBeInTheDocument()), which passes before the stale promise settles. With `await act(async()=>{finish(...); await 50ms})` the unmutated code is green and the mutant red (k7.probe.summary.txt), so the production guard works; only the test is weak.

title: ExtractionReviewPage friendly refusal text never fires against the real apiFetch error
evidence: message() in ExtractionReviewPage.tsx matches /forbidden|unauthorized/ and /conflict|sources_changed/ on error.message, but apps/web/src/api/client.ts:122 builds the message as `HTTP <status>` and carries the server code in ApiError.code. Live run (browser-u22-extraction-review-ui-2026-10-26-checker/report.json) showed 'HTTP 403' for an automation key and 'HTTP 409 Your judgment was not accepted.' for a CAS refusal; the 'trusted human reviewer' / 'source or review revision changed' guidance never appears. Unit tests pass only because they mock Error('extraction_review_forbidden'). Refusals are still visible and counts do not advance, so no criterion fails. Fix direction: also test ApiError.code/status in message().

title: process: M check passed the 10-minute checkpoint (wall about 16 min)
evidence: qa/verdicts/u22-extraction-review-ui.md Metrics: slow browser bring-up 8 min (Playwright MCP held by another session's profile, claude-in-chrome extension not connected, own headless Chrome over CDP plus a router-backed mock store). Policy .8-6 requires a process row.
